description: Queue up to 100 URLs as one asynchronous job and collect the results later by batch_id, so a large list never blocks your run. Use when you have more than 20 URLs or do not need results immediately; for 2-20 URLs with results now use alterlab_batch_scrape. Cost: the alterlab_scrape rate per URL, from $0.0002 up to $0.02. Each URL can have its own mode, formats and extraction_schema. Returns a batch_id immediately; results are available from GET /api/v1/batch/{batch_id}. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

extraction_schema.description: JSON schema for structured extraction. Fields matching this schema are extracted from the page. Example: { "title": "string", "price": "number" }. LLM extraction needs your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, etc.) added in the dashboard BYOK settings; without one the request is rejected with byok_key_required and not charged.

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr
